newsitem.title: UK: EMS/MARK PUSHES HIGHER VS NORDICS IN EUROPE.
newsitem.headline: EMS/MARK PUSHES HIGHER VS NORDICS IN EUROPE.

text.p: The mark charged higher against its Nordic satellites in Europe, settling near four-week peaks at the midsession against the Norwegian and Swedish crowns.
General mark strength combined on Thursday with jitters ahead of Norway's September election and thin summer volumes to give the mark a leg-up against the Nordic satellites.
"Pressure on the Norwegian crown has been building as the election approaches," said a European bank trader.
And the Swedish crown, said dealers, slid on the coat-tails of mark/Norwegian crown's stumble.
"But liquidity is also quite bad," added the trader.
